description: Core 1 (CPI excluding food and fuel) and core 2 (CPI excluding food, fuel and precious metals), all-India combined, RBI definitions: linked index from Jan 2014, y/y from Jan 2015. Asia Decoded calculation: 2024 base from Jan 2025 (MoSPI item indices and weights); 2012 base 2014-2024 (residual of MoSPI's headline, RBI method), linked over 2025; Mar-May 2020 petrol, diesel, gold and silver imputed from PPAC and RBI market prices. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/cpi_core/in_cpi_core.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India core CPI, calculated
